# The proposed solutions register

**A proposal is a solution on the shelf, arguing a shape it would answer, binding nothing.** A proposal specific to one problem lives as a comment on that problem's issue; an orphaned or multifarious one gets its own issue. Both are first-class rows here, and the `where` column says which.

A proposal is admitted if it has a **source** and at least one **shape**. **Search by shape** — the symptom you have — rather than by the name you were going to give your solution. A research pass may mint a proposal directly: a proposal binds nothing, and only adoption, dismissal and problems bind ([ADR-0029](../adr/0029-a-problem-is-minted-by-a-human-a-proposal-is-not.md)).


**Before you implement anything, read all three registers**, and say in your PR
body what you found — `docs/agents/registers.md`, *Before you implement
anything*. "Nothing relevant" is a complete answer and the expected one; silence
is not, because an instruction nobody can tell was skipped decays.

## By shape

The index. Arriving with a symptom, look for it here — stating a shape never bound the proposal to a problem, so a shape may be listed against a proposal that answers nothing yet.

* **82 of 150 predicting cells have no delta-proof route from their own chart back into `encode`, as an unchosen residual of construction** — Give rim cells a private route: non-zero `p_v` at level 1 ([#316](https://github.com/NGL321/patchworks/issues/316))
* **A capacity question the record has never asked: whether a map that is a parameter, rather than a function of what it is transporting, is enough** — Input-conditioned restriction maps: `F_ev` becomes a function of the node stalk ([#319](https://github.com/NGL321/patchworks/issues/319))
* **A carrier for attention, if attention ever leaves the fog: a route by which one region's state can reach another without climbing the taper** — Relay cells: a long-distance node laid over the graph ([#312](https://github.com/NGL321/patchworks/issues/312))
* **A figure that a measurement has superseded goes on standing in a pass condition, a bound, or an ADR's Decision, because nothing indexes where figures are quoted** — A register of load-bearing measured figures, generated like the constant registers ([#321](https://github.com/NGL321/patchworks/issues/321))
* **A new domain needs a topology and there is no principle that produces one — the wedge is a second hand-written graph beside the first** — An undifferentiated graph, carved by sparsity rather than designed ([#320](https://github.com/NGL321/patchworks/issues/320))
* **A ruling supersedes a number and the sweep for its other statements is set by what the ruling's author happened to know** — A register of load-bearing measured figures, generated like the constant registers ([#321](https://github.com/NGL321/patchworks/issues/321))
* **A structured `K` would make the stability band free rather than enforced, removing a post-step correction from the learning rule** — Direct parameterisation of a stable `K`, in place of projection after the step ([#318](https://github.com/NGL321/patchworks/issues/318))
* **Bias drift walks cells across activation-region boundaries, and the obvious remedies are all ruled out by ADR-0019's shape argument** — Bound the fold's velocity, not its position: a cap on `‖Δb‖` per tick ([#317](https://github.com/NGL321/patchworks/issues/317))
